metadata.description: Daily GitHub repo scout for product, design and dev teams

plugins.name: repo-hunter
plugins.description: Finds GitHub repos gaining 200+ stars in a day (Trending + Search API + star snapshots), prioritises tools for product teams, skips repos you already use or saw recently, compares each with existing alternatives (strengths, weaknesses, 5 reasons for/against) and logs every daily run to Notion.
